metadata.prompt: A dark, high-contrast image of a sniper's crosshairs centered on a stylized LinkedIn profile card.
A floating constellation of social media icons connected by glowing, thin threads of data.
A digital puzzle where the final pieces being clicked into place are names and dates.
A silhouette of a person in a hoodie sitting in a dimly lit coffee shop, their face illuminated by the blue light of a laptop.
A glowing 3D blueprint of a modern office, with red translucent icons appearing over áreas like 'SERVER ROOM'.
A human figure standing alone under a harsh white spotlight, with dozens of mechanical cameras clicking in the shadows.
A pair of hands physically closing a thick velvet curtain over a glowing digital screen.
A stylized 'Settings' menu where a switch is being toggled from a red 'PUBLIC' to a green 'PRIVATE'.
A robotic eye scanning a stream of social media posts, highlighting 'PII' (Personally Identifiable Information).
A close-up of a photo of an office desk, where a security badge is being highlighted by a red 'EXPOSED' alert.
A semi-transparent blue shield made of overlapping hexagons forming over a mosaic of family photos.

content.narrative: Before the first email is sent, the attacker is watching. They are conducting OSINT—Open Source Intelligence gathering. Your social media is a blueprint of your life. Every 'Happy Birthday' post, every 'First Day at Work' photo, is a data point. They aren't looking for our firewall. They are looking for your vulnerabilities. Your mother's maiden name. Your first car. They use this Tactical Recon to build a 'Persona of Trust'. When they call you, they don't sound like a stranger; they sound like a friend. They know who you work with. They know what software we use. You are providing the ammunition for your own deception. The protocol for Signal Recovery is: Information Sanitization. Audit your digital footprint. If it is public, it is weaponizable. We are going to run a Recon Scan. I will show you a profile. You will identify the data points that are vulnerable. Stop handing out the blueprint to our perimeter. Initiate recon audit.
content.persona_direction: Rogue AI (The Glitch) - Observational, cold, threatening tone.
content.speaker: Rogue AI

content: Data Points: Names, Locations, Software, Vendors
Risk: Social media posts used as 'Social Engineering' fuel
Defense: Tighten privacy settings & sanitize public info

content.question: What is 'OSINT' (Open Source Intelligence)?
options: Information gathered from public sources like social media to profile a target.
A type of secure internal operating system.
content.correct_answer: Information gathered from public sources like social media to profile a target.

scenarios.text: The person has their lanyard/ID badge visible in the reflection of the window.
scenarios.feedback: Even blurred or reflected badges provide enough info for attackers to clone access cards.
